description:
Shipped reference docs narrate past behavior instead of stating current behavior: the labels reference cites a retired registry file, the command-grammar reference describes a completed short-flag migration as in-flight conformance work, and the command reference explains what callers used to do. The labels reference also omits the enforces namespace from its pre-declared registry list.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Shipped reference docs state current behavior only; no formerly/previously/no-longer narration remains
- [hard] REQ-02: The command-grammar doc reads as a statement of the current grammar
- [hard] REQ-03: The pre-declared namespace list in the labels reference matches the init scaffold, including enforces
title: Remove legacy narration from shipped reference docs
